legend.text: S-hook onto WOE (WOES) -- the obvious bingo lane
Down the V of VIRGA -- rarer, but higher-scoring and dangerous
Alongside the Y of JUDY -- least likely (needs the last A)
A C-play hooking CLOSE (LOSE -> CLOSE) down to the H15 triple: ~25-37
A possible 3-letter outplay: an A (at B6) alongside the Y of JUDY

states.caption: Here Mike has already bingoed 14D RETAILS (hooking WOES). Nigel's plan: a CLOSE hook to the H15 triple once he draws the C, then the 3-letter out with an A at B6.

Why not ALLEE: after B6 ALLEE (Nigel 395) and Mike's reply 14E RULIEST (396), Nigel holds CEINNTT with only A,D unseen -- and cannot reach a triple with a CLOSE hook (his best is ENCLOSE for ~12). Mike's leftover A,D win.

legend.text: S-hook onto WOE -> WOES: a bingo through J14
S-hook onto YEET -> YEETS: a bingo down column O to O8

states.caption: If Nigel plays a word and Mike sets up 8K YEET (holding an S), Mike threatens a bingo ending in S in TWO places -- WOES and YEETS -- and Nigel cannot block both.
